test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some mugs are cups.

No paper is a mug.

Conclusions:

(I) Some cups are mugs.

(II) No paper is a cup.
solution:
Given Statements:

 
• Some mugs are cups.
 
• No paper is a mug.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3628dc92eb8533f5b3c054933c7bd10f32dcbe137fbe79067e851242d4c1dee8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9a83dd952e716a33708e9596775061a9acfc537c71cde5cd1bde7146ed29192.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cups are mugs - **True** (This is a direct conversion of the first statement. If "Some mugs are cups", then it logically follows that "Some cups are mugs".)

II. No paper is a cup - **False **(There is no direct relationship between 'Paper' and 'Cups, so 'No paper is a cup' does not logically follow.)

So, only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
